caption: The drawing depicts a single sofa set against a plain, light beige background. The sofa has a geometric, rectangular form with straight lines defining the backrest and armrests, which are the same height. The upholstery is shaded in various tones of deep green and teal, giving dimension to the seat, back, and arm panels. The sofa frame and legs are depicted in black, with cylindrical and turned details on the four legs. Each leg has a small gold foot cap. Gold bands accent the top and bottom of the armrest posts, as well as the horizontal trim along the sofa's base and upper edge, adding decorative contrast. There are no other objects or decorations in the drawing. The composition is centered with the entire sofa visible and is bordered by a thin, double-lined rectangular frame.
title: Sofa (Empire)
